title: Interactive Search: Language Sorting
body: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior When searching for an episode or a season from the interactive search, sorting the results by languages does not work. (Other filters and ordering are applied). In the screenshot below, I sorted the results by languages in descending order, this should display as follow: ***Unknown -> Hindi -> English***. ### Expected Behavior When ordering by languages results should be ordered according to the language list. ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Go to an episode 2. Run the interactive search 3. Order by languages the results ### Environment ```markdown - OS: Linux - Sonarr: 4.0.20.3014 - Docker Install: Yes - Using Reverse Proxy: Yes - Browser: Safari - Database: Sqlite 3.53.4 ``` ### What branch are you running? Main ### Trace Logs UI Issue. There are no relevant logs. ### Anything else _No response_
author: SebanDan
